payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance whose open combat moves on, when the command names no target; never written. Nothing else is sent: « Suivant » passes the turn to the next participant in rank order that initiative_order_view does not skip, a dead NPC being skipped there (dead-derived), a hidden one taking its turn at its rank (hidden-keeps-rank), and adds a round when it wraps past the last rank (next-turn, Initiative@1). The command lands on the combat's own row and writes its currentEntryId and its round's step, 0 or 1. An instance with no open combat, or whose participants are all dead, is refused
